entities.name: Talaromycosis
entities.description: A life-threatening systemic opportunistic fungal infection caused by the thermally dimorphic fungus Talaromyces marneffei, predominantly affecting severely immunocompromised individuals (notably advanced HIV with CD4 < 100 cells/uL and patients with anti-IFN-gamma autoantibodies) in endemic Southeast Asia and southern China, characterized by reticuloendothelial dissemination and umbilicated necrotic papules.

entities.name: High Remittent Fever
entities.description: High remittent or spiking fever (39-40°C) with prominent chills and diaphoresis reflecting uncontrolled systemic reticuloendothelial fungemia.

entities.name: Profound Weight Loss
entities.description: Rapid, severe cachectic weight loss and profound anorexia, often losing >10% of total body mass within several weeks.

entities.name: Generalized Lymphadenopathy
entities.description: Widespread non-tender enlargement of cervical, axillary, epitrochlear, and inguinal lymph node chains due to fungal infiltration.

entities.name: Firm Hepatosplenomegaly
entities.description: Prominent enlargement of both liver and spleen secondary to diffuse reticuloendothelial histiocytic hyperplasia.

entities.name: Pulmonary Talaromycosis
entities.description: Pulmonary involvement presenting with productive cough, progressive dyspnea, pleuritic chest discomfort, and occasional hemoptysis in over half of patients.

entities.name: Intestinal Mucosal Ulceration
entities.description: Disseminated fungal seeding causing extensive mucosal ulcerations throughout the ileum, cecum, and colon.

entities.name: Chronic Watery Diarrhea
entities.description: Persistent watery or mucoid diarrhea accompanied by lower abdominal cramping and malabsorption from intestinal fungal infiltration.

entities.name: Lower Gastrointestinal Bleeding
entities.description: Erosion of ulcerated bowel mucosa by fungal granulomas triggering overt hematochezia, melena, or acute blood loss.

entities.name: Bowel Perforation
entities.description: Transmural necrosis from deep intestinal ulcerations leading to acute bowel perforation and secondary peritonitis.

entities.name: Multifocal Osteolytic Lesions
entities.description: Multiple punched-out destructive bone lesions affecting the calvarium, ribs, sternum, clavicles, and long bones, especially in non-HIV hosts.

entities.name: Suppurative Osteomyelitis
entities.description: Direct osseous fungal proliferation leading to chronic suppurative osteomyelitis with localized bone pain and cortical destruction.

entities.name: Pathologic Bone Fractures
entities.description: Severe cortical osteolysis and structural weakening of weight-bearing or axial bones resulting in acute pathologic fractures.

entities.name: Suppurative Septic Arthritis
entities.description: Fungal seeding of synovium inducing monoarticular or polyarticular septic arthritis with inflammatory joint effusion.

entities.name: Subcutaneous Cold Abscesses
entities.description: Fluctuant, painless, or minimally inflamed subcutaneous cold abscesses containing purulent necrotic fluid.

entities.name: Oral Mucosal Ulcers
entities.description: Painful or painless crateriform ulcers on the hard palate, soft palate, gingiva, and buccal mucosa.

entities.name: Tongue Necrotic Granulomas
entities.description: Indurated, ulcerative granulomatous plaques and nodules on the dorsum and lateral borders of the tongue.

entities.name: Laryngeal Granulomatous Obstruction
entities.description: Laryngeal mucosal involvement producing progressive hoarseness, dysphonia, and potentially fatal upper airway obstruction with inspiratory stridor.

entities.name: Drenching Night Sweats
entities.description: Severe nocturnal diaphoresis occurring regularly in conjunction with evening temperature spikes and macrophage activation.

entities.name: Severe Progressive Cachexia
entities.description: Widespread systemic fungemia driving rapid temporal, facial, and limb skeletal muscle wasting.

entities.name: Fungal Sepsis Syndrome
entities.description: High circulating fungal burden producing severe sepsis syndrome with hemodynamic collapse, lactic acidosis, and organ dysfunction.

entities.name: Septic Shock
entities.description: Overwhelming bloodstream dissemination triggering profound refractory vasodilation and tissue hypoperfusion requiring vasopressor resuscitation.

entities.name: Secondary HLH
entities.description: Life-threatening reactive hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis provoked by uncontrolled intracellular fungal replication.

entities.name: Disseminated Intravascular Coagulation
entities.description: Severe endothelial injury and systemic inflammation triggering consumptive coagulopathy with petechiae, ecchymoses, and microvascular thrombosis.

entities.name: Fungal Meningoencephalitis
entities.description: Subacute fungal meningitis or encephalitis characterized by altered sensorium, headache, and cranial neuropathies.

entities.name: Fungal Brain Abscess
entities.description: Hematogenous intracranial seeding producing focal parenchymal fungal granulomas or necrotic brain abscesses.

entities.name: Focal Neurological Deficits
entities.description: Cerebral ring-enhancing lesions or vasculitic infarctions causing focal motor weakness, aphasia, or sensory deficits.

entities.name: Fungal Chorioretinitis
entities.description: Hematogenous intraocular seeding manifesting as white retinal exudates, focal chorioretinitis, and vitritis.

entities.name: Endophthalmitis
entities.description: Severe fungal ocular dissemination progressing to destructive endophthalmitis with severe eye pain, conjunctival injection, and hypopyon.

entities.name: Exudative Pleural Effusion
entities.description: Subpleural pulmonary fungal necrosis and pleural inflammation inducing unilateral or bilateral exudative pleural effusions.

entities.name: Peritoneal Ascites
entities.description: Reticuloendothelial hepatic infiltration and peritoneal granulomatosis resulting in exudative or transudative peritoneal ascites.

entities.name: Pericardial Effusion
entities.description: Contiguous spread from mediastinal adenopathy or hematogenous pericardial seeding causing serous or hemorrhagic pericardial effusion.

entities.name: Renal Fungal Granulomas
entities.description: Hematogenous dissemination generating cortical microabscesses and granulomas causing flank pain and microscopic hematuria.

entities.name: Primary Adrenal Insufficiency
entities.description: Bilateral fungal infiltration and necrosis of adrenal glands precipitating Addisonian crisis with refractory hypotension and electrolyte derangements.

entities.name: Genital Necrotic Ulcers
entities.description: Painful or painless necrotic ulcers and umbilicated nodules on the glans penis, scrotum, or vulva.

entities.name: Necrotizing Cellulitis
entities.description: Extensive, poorly demarcated, erythematous necrotizing cellulitis driven by deep dermal fungal proliferation.

entities.name: Acute Respiratory Distress
entities.description: Rapid alveolar fungal exudation precipitating acute respiratory distress syndrome requiring mechanical ventilation.

entities.name: Cutaneous Gangrene
entities.description: Thrombosis of dermal microvessels secondary to intense perivascular fungal invasion leading to localized focal cutaneous gangrene.

entities.name: Mesenteric Lymphadenitis
entities.description: Extensive fungal seeding of mesenteric and retroperitoneal lymph nodes causing abdominal distension and dull pain.

entities.name: Suppurative Parotitis
entities.description: Fungal dissemination to salivary glands producing tender, unilateral or bilateral suppurative parotid enlargement.

entities.name: Splenic Infarction
entities.description: Severe splenomegaly and fungal microvascular occlusion triggering acute splenic infarction with sharp left upper quadrant pain.

entities.name: Umbilicated Necrotic Papules
entities.description: Pathognomonic dome-shaped papules with central necrotic crateriform depression or black crust presenting the smoking-gun sign in 70-85% of cases.

entities.name: Facial Papular Distribution
entities.description: Striking anatomic predilection of necrotic papules for the face, including forehead, periorbital margins, nose, and chin.

entities.name: Upper Trunk Papules
entities.description: Characteristic dense clustering of umbilicated necrotic lesions across the neck, upper chest, shoulders, and upper back.

entities.name: Molluscum-Like Papules
entities.description: Cutaneous papules that mimic molluscum contagiosum in shape but are distinguished by central necrosis, black eschar, and rapid systemic course.

entities.name: Auricular Cutaneous Papules
entities.description: Dome-shaped necrotic papules frequently erupting on pinnae and earlobes, offering accessible bedside scrape sites.

entities.name: Crateriform Palatal Ulcer
entities.description: Discrete punched-out mucosal ulceration with indurated borders on the hard or soft palate noted during oral examination.

entities.name: Lingual Ulcerated Plaques
entities.description: Indurated ulcerative plaques along lateral margins or dorsum of the tongue discovered on oral cavity inspection.

entities.name: Massive Splenomegaly
entities.description: Palpable, firm, non-tender or tender spleen extending >4-6 cm below the left costal margin.

entities.name: Firm Hepatomegaly
entities.description: Smooth, firm, non-pulsatile liver edge palpable 3 to 6 cm below the right costal margin.

entities.name: Cervical Adenopathy
entities.description: Prominent, firm, non-tender, non-fluctuant lymph nodes palpable in anterior and posterior cervical triangles.

entities.name: Epitrochlear Lymphadenopathy
entities.description: Palpable enlargement of epitrochlear lymph nodes proximal to the medial humeral epicondyle indicating systemic disease.

entities.name: Axillary Lymphadenopathy
entities.description: Bilateral firm, mobile, non-matted axillary lymph node enlargement palpated during admission physical examination.

entities.name: Temporal Muscle Wasting
entities.description: Bitemporal hollowing and facial muscle atrophy indicating severe, prolonged catabolic cachexia.

entities.name: Severe Mucocutaneous Pallor
entities.description: Pronounced pallor of conjunctivae, mucous membranes, and palmar creases reflecting severe normocytic anemia.

entities.name: Subcutaneous Cold Nodules
entities.description: Fluctuant, non-erythematous, non-tender subcutaneous fluid collections tracking along fascial tissue planes.

entities.name: Focal Calvarial Tenderness
entities.description: Exquisite focal point tenderness upon gentle digital palpation of the skull calvarium over osteolytic defects.

entities.name: Sternal Bone Tenderness
entities.description: Focal bone tenderness elicited over the manubrium or sternal body indicating fungal marrow and cortical infiltration.

entities.name: Inspiratory Lung Crackles
entities.description: Bilateral fine or coarse inspiratory crackles auscultated over mid and lower pulmonary zones.

entities.name: Inspiratory Stridor
entities.description: High-pitched inspiratory sound heard over the extrathoracic trachea signaling critical laryngeal granulomatous edema.

entities.name: Abdominal Distension
entities.description: Tense or protuberant abdominal contour with visible superficial venous collaterals caused by massive organomegaly.

entities.name: Shifting Dullness
entities.description: Positive shifting dullness and fluid wave to abdominal percussion demonstrating free peritoneal fluid collection.

entities.name: Scleral Icterus
entities.description: Yellow discoloration of bulbar conjunctivae and sclerae indicating hepatic parenchymal dysfunction or hemolysis.

entities.name: Cutaneous Petechiae
entities.description: Pinpoint non-blanching violaceous petechial spots on distal lower extremities reflecting severe thrombocytopenia.

entities.name: Nuchal Rigidity
entities.description: Resistance to passive neck flexion with positive Kernig or Brudzinski signs in fungal meningoencephalitis.

entities.name: Retinal Roth Spots
entities.description: Pale retinal lesions surrounded by rings of hemorrhage identified during ophthalmoscopic examination.

entities.name: Inflammatory Monoarthritis
entities.description: Swollen, warm, tender large joint with marked limitation of active and passive joint motion.

entities.name: Periorbital Soft-Tissue Edema
entities.description: Bilateral non-pitting periorbital puffiness and facial edema surrounding confluent papular skin lesions.

entities.name: Hoarseness of Voice
entities.description: Rough, raspy, or breathy phonation detected during clinical interview indicating vocal cord granulomatous ulceration.

entities.name: Transverse Septate Yeasts
entities.description: Direct microscopy demonstrating 3-8 µm intracellular yeast cells featuring pathognomonic central transverse dividing septa.

entities.name: Binary Fission Division
entities.description: Cytological verification of yeast multiplication strictly by binary fission without budding morphogenesis.

entities.name: Macrophage Yeast Ingestion
entities.description: Microscopic visualization of reticuloendothelial histiocytes and monocytes heavily engorged with round or oval fungal cells.

entities.name: Diffusible Red Pigment
entities.description: Secretion of soluble brick-red to deep wine-red pigment diffusing through Sabouraud dextrose agar at 25°C within 3-5 days.

entities.name: Thermal Dimorphic Conversion
entities.description: Laboratory verification of phenotypic phase shift from filamentous mould at 25°C to yeast form at 37°C.

entities.name: Severe CD4 Lymphopenia
entities.description: Profound depression of helper T-lymphocytes with absolute CD4+ count < 100 cells/µL, frequently < 50 cells/µL.

entities.name: Profound Normocytic Anemia
entities.description: Severe normocytic normochromic anemia with hemoglobin dropping below 7-8 g/dL and normal mean corpuscular volume.

entities.name: Severe Thrombocytopenia
entities.description: Peripheral platelet count dropping below 50,000/µL secondary to splenic sequestration and marrow infiltration.

entities.name: Severe Leukopenia
entities.description: Admission total white blood cell count suppressed below 3,000/µL reflecting marrow hypoplasia and hypersplenism.

entities.name: Bone Marrow Pancytopenia
entities.description: Concurrent depression of red cells, granulocytes, and platelets due to dense histiocytic marrow infiltration.

entities.name: Elevated Alkaline Phosphatase
entities.description: Serum alkaline phosphatase elevated 3-5 times upper limit of normal due to hepatic reticuloendothelial granulomas.

entities.name: Elevated Gamma-Glutamyl Transferase
entities.description: Serum GGT elevated in parallel with alkaline phosphatase reflecting infiltrative hepatic granulomatous disease.

entities.name: Moderate Serum Transaminitis
entities.description: Mild-to-moderate elevation of serum AST and ALT to 2-3 times upper normal limit from focal hepatocyte necrosis.

entities.name: Normal Serum Bilirubin
entities.description: Total and direct bilirubin remaining within normal or near-normal range creating a classic infiltrative enzyme profile.

entities.name: Extreme Hyperferritinemia
entities.description: Serum ferritin soaring above 1,000 to 10,000 ng/mL driven by intense macrophage activation and secondary HLH.

entities.name: Elevated C-Reactive Protein
entities.description: Marked elevation of admission CRP (>50-100 mg/L) reflecting severe systemic acute-phase inflammatory response.

entities.name: Markedly Elevated ESR
entities.description: Erythrocyte sedimentation rate rising above 80-100 mm/h secondary to hypergammaglobulinemia and tissue necrosis.

entities.name: Elevated Lactate Dehydrogenase
entities.description: Serum LDH elevated to >500-1,000 U/L reflecting rapid cell turnover, fungal burden, and tissue destruction.

entities.name: Elevated Beta-D-Glucan
entities.description: Serum (1,3)-beta-D-glucan elevated to >500 pg/mL providing sensitive pan-fungal diagnostic evidence.

entities.name: Serum Mp1p Antigenemia
entities.description: Positive enzyme immunoassay detecting circulating cell-wall mannoprotein Mp1p of Talaromyces marneffei.

entities.name: Urine Mp1p Antigenuria
entities.description: Rapid non-invasive detection of Mp1p fungal mannoprotein in patient urine samples.

entities.name: Positive Blood Culture
entities.description: Lysis-centrifugation fungal blood cultures yielding mould colonies within 48 to 96 hours of incubation at 25°C.

entities.name: Bone Marrow Histiocytosis
entities.description: Bone marrow cytology and biopsy demonstrating sheets of histiocytes filled with fission-dividing yeast cells.

entities.name: Skin Scraping Cytology
entities.description: Rapid bedside touch imprint or scraping of umbilicated crust stained with Wright or Giemsa revealing septate yeasts.

entities.name: GMS Septate Staining
entities.description: Gomori methenamine silver staining clearly demonstrating intensely argyrophilic yeast cells with transverse septation.

entities.name: Hypoalbuminemia
entities.description: Marked depression of serum albumin (<2.5-3.0 g/dL) reflecting negative acute-phase response and severe wasting.

entities.name: Reticulonodular Chest Infiltrates
entities.description: Chest radiograph displaying diffuse bilateral interstitial reticulonodular infiltrates across all lung fields.

entities.name: Patchy Alveolar Consolidation
entities.description: Thoracic imaging demonstrating patchy, non-segmental alveolar consolidations and ground-glass pulmonary opacities.

entities.name: Cavitary Pulmonary Nodules
entities.description: High-resolution CT revealing multiple thick- or thin-walled cavitary lesions located predominantly in upper lung zones.

entities.name: Mediastinal Lymphadenopathy
entities.description: Contrast-enhanced chest CT showing marked paratracheal, subcarinal, and hilar lymph node enlargement.

entities.name: Hepatic Microabscesses
entities.description: Bedside abdominal ultrasound and CT showing hepatomegaly with multiple tiny hypoechoic microabscesses (<1 cm).

entities.name: Splenic Microabscesses
entities.description: Abdominal ultrasound demonstrating splenomegaly peppered with numerous tiny hypoechoic microabscesses.

entities.name: Mesenteric Adenopathy
entities.description: Abdominal ultrasound and CT demonstrating multiple rounded, hypoechoic mesenteric and retroperitoneal lymph nodes (>1.5 cm).

entities.name: Punched-Out Osteolysis
entities.description: Plain radiography and bone CT showing well-circumscribed, punched-out osteolytic bone destruction lacking periosteal reaction.

entities.name: Calvarial Lytic Lesions
entities.description: Skull radiographs demonstrating multiple discrete radiolucent osteolytic defects eroding inner and outer cortical tables.

entities.name: Fungal Spondylodiscitis
entities.description: Spine MRI showing vertebral endplate erosion, intervertebral disc narrowing, and epidural abscess formation.

entities.name: Subcutaneous Fluid Collections
entities.description: Bedside soft-tissue ultrasound revealing complex hypoechoic fluid collections representing cold abscesses.

entities.name: Pleural Blunting
entities.description: Chest radiography demonstrating costophrenic angle blunting indicative of inflammatory reactive pleural effusion.

entities.name: Endemic Southeast Asia
entities.description: Geographic residence or travel in tropical Southeast Asia, including Thailand, Vietnam, Myanmar, Laos, and Cambodia.

entities.name: Southern China Travel
entities.description: Travel or residency history in southern Chinese provinces, including Guangxi, Guangdong, Yunnan, and Hong Kong.

entities.name: Northeast India Residence
entities.description: Residence or travel in endemic zones of Northeast India, particularly Manipur and Assam.

entities.name: Bamboo Rat Burrows
entities.description: Environmental proximity to wild bamboo rats (Rhizomys pruinosus and Cannomys badius) and their subterranean burrows.

entities.name: Agricultural Soil Contact
entities.description: Occupational contact with disturbed agricultural soil, farming, digging, and rural land preparation.

entities.name: Monsoon Rainy Season
entities.description: Marked transmission peak occurring during the high-humidity monsoon season from May through October.

entities.name: Conidial Aerosol Inhalation
entities.description: Inhalation of microscopic airborne environmental conidia from disturbed soil into pulmonary alveoli.

entities.name: Bamboo Rat Butchering
entities.description: Direct contact, skinning, butchering, and culinary handling of wild bamboo rat carcasses.

entities.name: Subterranean Cave Exploration
entities.description: Caving and spelunking in rural karst limestone caverns harboring rodent colonies and microclimates.

entities.name: Forestry Occupational Exposure
entities.description: Clearing bamboo groves, logging, and forestry operations that disturb forest floors and disperse fungal spores.

entities.name: Monsoon Flood Silt
entities.description: Direct contact with muddy floodwaters and displaced soil sediment following seasonal monsoon floods.

entities.name: Advanced HIV Infection
entities.description: Advanced untreated or virologically failing HIV infection with profound CD4 lymphopenia below 100 cells/µL.

entities.name: Anti-IFN-Gamma Autoantibodies
entities.description: Adult-onset immunodeficiency syndrome characterized by neutralizing autoantibodies against interferon-gamma.

entities.name: Hematologic Malignancy
entities.description: Underlying hematologic neoplasms, including chronic lymphocytic leukemia, non-Hodgkin lymphoma, and myeloma.

entities.name: Solid Organ Transplantation
entities.description: Allograft recipients receiving calcineurin inhibitors, antimetabolites, and chronic immunosuppressive regimens.

entities.name: Anti-CD20 Therapy
entities.description: Pharmacological B-cell depletion with rituximab or obinutuzumab causing profound secondary immunodeficiency.

entities.name: Bruton Kinase Inhibitors
entities.description: Treatment with ibrutinib or acalabrutinib blunting macrophage and fungal host defense mechanisms.

entities.name: Prolonged Corticosteroid Therapy
entities.description: High-dose systemic glucocorticoid therapy suppressing cell-mediated immunity and macrophage fungicidal function.

entities.name: Janus Kinase Inhibitors
entities.description: Targeted immunosuppression with tofacitinib, baricitinib, or ruxolitinib inhibiting cytokine signaling.

entities.name: HLA-DRB1*1602 Genotype
entities.description: Genetic human leukocyte antigen alleles conferring high susceptibility to anti-IFN-gamma autoantibody formation.

entities.name: Incubation of Weeks
entities.description: Typical symptom onset developing 1 to 3 weeks following acute high-inoculum environmental inhalation.

entities.name: Decade Latent Reactivation
entities.description: Prolonged clinical latency with fungal reactivation occurring years to decades following travel departure.

entities.name: Narrow-Necked Budding Yeasts
entities.description: Observation of narrow-necked budding yeasts on microscopic examination ruling out Talaromyces fission morphogenesis.

entities.name: Broad-Based Budding Yeasts
entities.description: Identification of large fungal cells with broad-based budding ruling out Talaromyces and confirming Blastomyces.

entities.name: Multiple Mariner-Wheel Budding
entities.description: Yeasts with circumferential multiple daughter buds in a mariner's wheel pattern establishing Paracoccidioides.

entities.name: Mucicarmine-Positive Capsule
entities.description: Demonstration of a prominent mucicarmine-positive polysaccharide capsule establishing Cryptococcus neoformans.

entities.name: Endosporulating Spherules
entities.description: Large, thick-walled spherules containing internal endospores ruling out Talaromyces and diagnosing Coccidioides.

entities.name: Acid-Fast Mycobacterial Bacilli
entities.description: Acid-fast bacilli on Ziehl-Neelsen stain ruling out fungal etiology and establishing Mycobacterial infection.

entities.name: Henderson-Paterson Bodies
entities.description: Large intracytoplasmic viral inclusion bodies on histology diagnosing Molluscum contagiosum virus.

entities.name: Absence of Endemic Travel
entities.description: Complete lifetime absence of travel or residency in Southeast Asia or southern China effectively excluding primary infection.

entities.name: Normal CD4 Count
entities.description: Normal CD4+ count (>500 cells/µL) in an immunocompetent host without autoantibodies strongly arguing against talaromycosis.

entities.name: Colorless Agar Culture
entities.description: Fungal culture on Sabouraud agar at 25°C failing to secrete a soluble red/wine pigment excluding Talaromyces marneffei.

entities.name: Rapid Antibacterial Response
entities.description: Prompt clinical defervescence and recovery within 48 to 72 hours of beta-lactam monotherapy ruling out fungal mycosis.

entities.name: Negative Mp1p Antigen
entities.description: Persistently undetectable serum and urine Mp1p enzyme immunoassays combined with negative blood cultures.

entities.name: Normal Beta-D-Glucan
entities.description: Completely undetectable serum (1,3)-beta-D-glucan in a symptomatic immunocompromised patient strongly arguing against systemic mycosis.

entities.name: Gram-Negative Bacilli Isolation
entities.description: Rapid recovery of Gram-negative bipolar safety-pin bacilli on blood or pus culture confirming melioidosis.

entities.name: Tissue Pseudohyphae Formation
entities.description: True branching pseudohyphae and budding blastoconidia in deep tissue specimens confirming invasive candidiasis.

entities.name: Aseptate Ribbon-Like Hyphae
entities.description: Broad, irregular, ribbon-like aseptate hyphae with right-angle branching diagnosing invasive Mucorales.

entities.name: Dichotomous 45-Degree Hyphae
entities.description: Uniform septate hyphae with 45-degree acute-angle dichotomous branching establishing invasive Aspergillosis.

entities.name: Normal Serum ALP
entities.description: Completely normal serum alkaline phosphatase and GGT in a patient with hepatosplenomegaly arguing against talaromycosis.

entities.name: Superficial Non-Systemic Lesions
entities.description: Isolated skin lesions completely lacking fever, weight loss, lymphadenopathy, or cytopenia ruling out disseminated disease.

entities.name: Kinetoplast-Containing Amastigotes
entities.description: Intracellular amastigotes containing a rod-shaped bar kinetoplast beside the nucleus confirming Leishmania.

entities.name: Dermatomal Vesicular Rash
entities.description: Strictly unilateral, dermatomal vesicular or crusted rash diagnosing herpes zoster infection.

entities.name: Positive Treponemal Serology
entities.description: Reactive RPR and treponemal antibody serology in palmar-plantar rash establishing secondary syphilis.

entities.name: Histoplasmosis
entities.description: Histoplasma capsulatum produces narrow-based budding yeasts without cross-wall septa and lacks diffusible red pigment on agar at 25°C.

entities.name: Cryptococcosis
entities.description: Cryptococcus neoformans is encapsulated, mucicarmine-positive, causes primarily meningoencephalitis, and reproduces by budding.

entities.name: Molluscum Contagiosum
entities.description: Molluscum contagiosum produces superficial umbilicated papules without systemic fever, cachexia, hepatosplenomegaly, or internal organ disease.

entities.name: Miliary Tuberculosis
entities.description: Miliary tuberculosis causes fever, wasting, and lung micronodules but lacks necrotic umbilicated facial papules, revealing acid-fast bacilli.

entities.name: Secondary Syphilis
entities.description: Secondary syphilis features widespread maculopapular rash on palms and soles with positive treponemal serology, but lacks central umbilicated necrosis.

entities.name: Visceral Leishmaniasis
entities.description: Visceral leishmaniasis shares fever, pancytopenia, and massive splenomegaly but amastigotes possess a distinct rod-shaped kinetoplast.

entities.name: Coccidioidomycosis
entities.description: Coccidioides immitis produces large endosporulating spherules (20-100 µm) in tissue and is endemic to arid American desert regions.

entities.name: Pneumocystis Jirovecii Pneumonia
entities.description: Pneumocystis presents with bilateral interstitial infiltrates in advanced HIV but entirely lacks umbilicated cutaneous papules or hepatosplenomegaly.

entities.name: Bacillary Angiomatosis
entities.description: Bartonella infection produces vascular, friable, non-umbilicated violaceous nodules that bleed easily, containing silver-stained bacilli.

entities.name: Cutaneous Leishmaniasis
entities.description: Cutaneous leishmaniasis manifests as localized, non-umbilicated chronic skin ulcers with raised borders without reticuloendothelial dissemination.

entities.name: Blastomycosis
entities.description: Blastomyces dermatitidis produces large (8-15 µm) yeasts with broad-based budding and thick refractory walls in North America.

entities.name: Paracoccidioidomycosis
entities.description: Paracoccidioides brasiliensis is restricted to Latin America and produces multiple budding daughter yeasts in a mariner's wheel pattern.

entities.name: Kaposi Sarcoma
entities.description: Kaposi sarcoma produces non-tender violaceous macules and plaques without central necrosis, demonstrating HHV-8 spindle cell proliferation.

entities.name: Cutaneous Aspergillosis
entities.description: Aspergillus produces necrotic skin eschars with 45-degree branching septate hyphae in tissue without intracellular yeast fission forms.

entities.name: Non-Hodgkin Lymphoma
entities.description: Non-Hodgkin lymphoma shares B-symptoms and lymphadenopathy but lymph node biopsy shows malignant clonal lymphoid proliferation without organisms.

entities.name: Scrub Typhus
entities.description: Orientia tsutsugamushi causes acute fever and lymphadenopathy with a single black eschar with red halo, resolving rapidly with doxycycline.

entities.name: Melioidosis
entities.description: Burkholderia pseudomallei causes severe bacteremia and visceral abscesses in Southeast Asia but is a Gram-negative bacillus responding to ceftazidime.

entities.name: Lepromatous Leprosy
entities.description: Lepromatous leprosy causes infiltrative facial plaques and earlobe thickening with peripheral nerve enlargement and sensory deficits.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS, bowel perforation, peritonitis, transmural necrosis, acute abdomen
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Transmural necrosis from deep intestinal ulcerations can lead to life-threatening acute bowel perforation and secondary peritonitis.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS, multifocal osteolytic lesions, bone destruction, osteolysis, anti-IFN-gamma
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Talaromycosis causes multiple punched-out destructive bone lesions affecting the calvarium, ribs, sternum, clavicles, and long bones, especially in non-HIV hosts.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS, suppurative osteomyelitis, bone infection, fungal osteitis
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Direct osseous fungal proliferation leads to chronic suppurative osteomyelitis characterized by localized bone pain, swelling, and cortical destruction.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS, pathologic bone fractures, cortical osteolysis, structural bone failure
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Severe cortical osteolysis and structural weakening of weight-bearing or axial bones frequently result in acute pathologic fractures.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS, suppurative septic arthritis, joint effusion, fungal arthritis, synovitis
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Fungal seeding of synovium induces monoarticular or polyarticular septic arthritis with inflammatory joint effusion and impaired mobility.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS, subcutaneous cold abscesses, cold abscess, fluctuant mass, soft tissue necrosis
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Fungal extension into subcutaneous soft tissues forms fluctuant, painless, or minimally inflamed cold abscesses containing purulent necrotic fluid.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS, oral mucosal ulcers, palate ulcer, buccal lesion, mucosal erosion
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Talaromycosis manifests as painful or painless crateriform ulcers on the hard palate, soft palate, gingiva, and buccal mucosa.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS, tongue necrotic granulomas, lingual plaque, oral granuloma
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Fungal infiltration of the lingual parenchyma causes indurated, ulcerative granulomatous plaques and nodules on the dorsum and lateral borders of the tongue.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS, laryngeal granulomatous obstruction, stridor, hoarseness, airway compromise
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Laryngeal mucosal involvement produces progressive hoarseness, dysphonia, and potentially fatal upper airway obstruction with inspiratory stridor.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS, drenching night sweats, diaphoresis, nocturnal sweating, constitutional symptom
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Severe nocturnal diaphoresis occurs regularly in conjunction with evening temperature spikes and intense systemic macrophage activation.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS, severe progressive cachexia, muscle wasting, catabolic state
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Widespread systemic fungemia and high circulating cytokine levels drive rapid temporal, facial, and limb skeletal muscle wasting.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS, fungal sepsis syndrome, fungemia, hemodynamic instability, lactic acidosis
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] High circulating fungal burden in the bloodstream produces severe sepsis syndrome characterized by hemodynamic collapse, lactic acidosis, and organ dysfunction.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS, septic shock, hypotension, vasopressor requirement, circulatory collapse
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Overwhelming bloodstream dissemination triggers profound refractory vasodilation and tissue hypoperfusion requiring vasopressor resuscitation.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS, secondary HLH, hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis, macrophage activation
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Disseminated intracellular infection can provoke life-threatening reactive hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis with uncontrolled hypercytokinemia.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS, disseminated intravascular coagulation, DIC, consumptive coagulopathy, thrombosis
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Severe endothelial injury and systemic inflammation trigger consumptive coagulopathy leading to petechiae, ecchymoses, and microvascular thrombosis.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS, fungal meningoencephalitis, central nervous system, meningitis, headache
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Central nervous system seeding leads to subacute fungal meningitis or encephalitis characterized by altered sensorium, headache, and cranial neuropathies.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS, fungal brain abscess, intracranial granuloma, cerebral mass lesion
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Hematogenous intracranial seeding produces focal parenchymal fungal granulomas or necrotic brain abscesses causing focal neurological deficits.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS, focal neurological deficits, motor weakness, aphasia, hemiparesis
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Cerebral ring-enhancing lesions or vasculitic infarctions cause focal motor weakness, aphasia, or sensory deficits.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS, fungal chorioretinitis, retinal exudates, vitritis, visual loss
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Hematogenous intraocular seeding manifests as white retinal exudates, focal chorioretinitis, and vitritis with progressive visual impairment.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS, endophthalmitis, ocular destruction, hypopyon, eye pain
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Severe fungal ocular dissemination can progress to destructive endophthalmitis with severe eye pain, conjunctival injection, and hypopyon.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS, exudative pleural effusion, pleural fluid, pleuritis, lung involvement
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Subpleural pulmonary fungal necrosis and pleural inflammation induce unilateral or bilateral exudative pleural effusions.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS, peritoneal ascites, peritoneal fluid, abdominal swelling, serosal effusion
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Reticuloendothelial hepatic infiltration, portal hypertension, and peritoneal granulomatosis result in exudative or transudative peritoneal ascites.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS, pericardial effusion, pericarditis, serosal effusion, cardiac tamponade
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Contiguous spread from mediastinal adenopathy or hematogenous pericardial seeding causes serous or hemorrhagic pericardial effusion.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS, renal fungal granulomas, nephromegaly, microscopic hematuria, renal seeding
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Hematogenous dissemination to the renal parenchyma generates cortical microabscesses and granulomas causing flank pain and microscopic hematuria.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS, primary adrenal insufficiency, Addisonian crisis, adrenal necrosis, hypotension
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Bilateral fungal infiltration and necrosis of the adrenal glands can precipitate Addisonian crisis with refractory hypotension and electrolyte derangements.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS, genital necrotic ulcers, penile ulcer, scrotal nodule, vulvar ulcer
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Cutaneous-mucosal seeding can present with painful or painless necrotic ulcers and umbilicated nodules on the glans penis, scrotum, or vulva.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS, necrotizing cellulitis, soft tissue infection, skin necrosis
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Deep dermal and subcutaneous fungal proliferation manifests as extensive, poorly demarcated, erythematous necrotizing cellulitis.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS, acute respiratory distress, ARDS, hypoxemic respiratory failure
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Rapid alveolar fungal exudation and diffuse bilateral infiltration can precipitate acute respiratory distress syndrome (ARDS) requiring mechanical ventilation.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS, cutaneous gangrene, dermal necrosis, microvascular thrombosis
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Thrombosis of dermal microvessels secondary to intense perivascular fungal invasion leads to localized focal cutaneous gangrene.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS, mesenteric lymphadenitis, abdominal adenopathy, dull abdominal pain
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Extensive fungal seeding of mesenteric and retroperitoneal lymph nodes causes profound abdominal distension, dull pain, and intestinal subocclusion.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS, suppurative parotitis, salivary gland swelling, parotid enlargement
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Fungal dissemination to the salivary glands can produce tender, unilateral or bilateral suppurative parotid enlargement.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS, splenic infarction, splenic necrosis, left upper quadrant pain
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Severe splenomegaly and fungal microvascular occlusion can trigger acute splenic infarction presenting with sharp left upper quadrant pleuritic pain.

relationships.keywords: HAS_PATHOGNOMONIC_HALLMARK, smoking gun, rules in, umbilicated papules, necrotic crust
relationships.description: [HAS_PATHOGNOMONIC_HALLMARK] Crops of firm, dome-shaped papules with pathognomonic central necrotic dells, crateriform depressions, or black hemorrhagic crusts represent the quintessential hallmark in 70-85% of cases.

relationships.keywords: HAS_PATHOGNOMONIC_HALLMARK, facial rash, facial distribution, central face papules
relationships.description: [HAS_PATHOGNOMONIC_HALLMARK] Papular cutaneous eruptions exhibit a striking anatomic predilection for the forehead, periorbital ridges, cheeks, nose, and chin.

relationships.keywords: HAS_PATHOGNOMONIC_HALLMARK, upper trunk distribution, neck papules, thoracic eruption
relationships.description: [HAS_PATHOGNOMONIC_HALLMARK] Widespread umbilicated papules and nodules consistently cluster across the neck, upper anterior chest, shoulders, and upper back.

relationships.keywords: HAS_PATHOGNOMONIC_HALLMARK, molluscum-like, pseudo-molluscum, umbilicated lesions
relationships.description: [HAS_PATHOGNOMONIC_HALLMARK] Cutaneous lesions closely mimic molluscum contagiosum but are differentiated by distinctive central necrotic black eschars and rapid systemic dissemination.

relationships.keywords: PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN, auricular lesions, earlobe papules, external ear
relationships.description: [PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN] Dome-shaped necrotic papules frequently erupt on the pinnae and earlobes, providing easily accessible bedside biopsy targets.

relationships.keywords: PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN, palatal ulcer, crateriform ulcer, oral examination
relationships.description: [PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN] Physical exam reveals punched-out, painless or painful crateriform mucosal ulcers with raised indurated borders on the hard or soft palate.

relationships.keywords: PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN, lingual plaque, tongue ulcer, oral physical sign
relationships.description: [PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN] Inspection of the oral cavity reveals discrete indurated, ulcerative granulomatous plaques along the lateral margins or dorsum of the tongue.

relationships.keywords: PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN, massive splenomegaly, splenic enlargement, left upper quadrant mass
relationships.description: [PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN] Abdominal palpation demonstrates prominent, firm, sometimes tender splenomegaly extending several fingerbreadths beneath the left costal margin.

relationships.keywords: PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN, firm hepatomegaly, liver edge, liver palpation
relationships.description: [PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN] Physical examination shows smooth, firm, non-pulsatile hepatomegaly palpable 3 to 6 cm below the right costal margin.

relationships.keywords: PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN, cervical adenopathy, neck lymph nodes, cervical examination
relationships.description: [PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN] Examination reveals prominent, non-tender, firm, discrete anterior and posterior cervical lymphadenopathy.

relationships.keywords: PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN, epitrochlear adenopathy, peripheral lymphadenopathy, physical sign
relationships.description: [PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN] Palpable enlargement of epitrochlear lymph nodes is frequently detected, signaling extensive systemic reticuloendothelial involvement.

relationships.keywords: PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN, axillary lymphadenopathy, axillary nodes, lymph node exam
relationships.description: [PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN] Bilateral firm, non-matted, mobile axillary lymph node enlargement is a common physical sign on admission triage.

relationships.keywords: PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN, temporal muscle wasting, bitemporal hollowing, cachexia sign
relationships.description: [PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN] Profound bitemporal hollowing and facial muscle wasting signify advanced chronic catabolic wasting syndrome.

relationships.keywords: PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN, conjunctival pallor, severe pallor, palmar pallor, anemia sign
relationships.description: [PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN] Striking palmar and conjunctival pallor on physical exam reflects profound normocytic anemia secondary to marrow suppression.

relationships.keywords: PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN, subcutaneous cold nodules, fluctuance, soft tissue nodule
relationships.description: [PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN] Palpation reveals fluctuant, non-erythematous subcutaneous nodules and cold abscesses tracking along fascial planes.

relationships.keywords: PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN, calvarial tenderness, skull point tenderness, osteolysis sign
relationships.description: [PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN] Gentle calvarial palpation elicits focal tenderness over punched-out skull osteolytic lesions, particularly in non-HIV patients.

relationships.keywords: PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN, sternal bone tenderness, marrow tenderness, sternal exam
relationships.description: [PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN] Point tenderness on sternal pressure signals direct osteolytic marrow infiltration and fungal bone involvement.

relationships.keywords: PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN, inspiratory lung crackles, pulmonary auscultation, rales
relationships.description: [PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN] Auscultation of the chest demonstrates bilateral fine or coarse inspiratory crackles and scattered bronchial breath sounds.

relationships.keywords: PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN, inspiratory stridor, airway compromise, laryngeal obstruction
relationships.description: [PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN] Audible high-pitched inspiratory stridor indicates critical laryngeal or upper subglottic fungal granulomatous narrowing.

relationships.keywords: PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN, abdominal distension, protuberant abdomen, abdominal examination
relationships.description: [PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN] Prominent abdominal distension with visible superficial collateral veins reflects massive organomegaly and developing ascites.

relationships.keywords: PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN, shifting dullness, fluid wave, ascites physical sign
relationships.description: [PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN] Percussion of the abdomen reveals positive shifting dullness and fluid wave reflecting clinically evident peritoneal ascites.

relationships.keywords: PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN, scleral icterus, jaundice, hepatic exam
relationships.description: [PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN] Examination of the sclerae reveals yellow icteric tinting in patients with extensive hepatic parenchymal infiltration or hemophagocytosis.

relationships.keywords: PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN, cutaneous petechiae, thrombocytopenic purpura, skin examination
relationships.description: [PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN] Pinpoint non-blanching petechial lesions on lower extremities indicate severe peripheral thrombocytopenia from marrow failure.

relationships.keywords: PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN, nuchal rigidity, meningismus, neck stiffness, neurological sign
relationships.description: [PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN] Meningismus with resistance to passive neck flexion is elicited in the subset of patients presenting with fungal meningoencephalitis.

relationships.keywords: PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN, retinal Roth spots, fundoscopy, retinal hemorrhages
relationships.description: [PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN] Fundoscopic examination may reveal pale retinal lesions with surrounding hemorrhage representing fungal microembolization.

relationships.keywords: PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN, inflammatory monoarthritis, swollen joint, joint examination
relationships.description: [PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN] Physical exam shows hot, swollen, tender large joints with active and passive motion severely limited by intra-articular fungal purulence.

relationships.keywords: PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN, periorbital soft-tissue edema, facial swelling, eye puffiness
relationships.description: [PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN] Facial examination reveals prominent non-pitting periorbital swelling surrounding necrotic papular eruptions.

relationships.keywords: PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN, hoarseness of voice, dysphonia, laryngeal sign
relationships.description: [PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN] Audible voice hoarseness and rasping phonation indicate vocal cord ulceration or direct laryngeal mucosal infiltration.

relationships.keywords: EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN, transverse septate yeasts, transverse septum, binary fission, cytology
relationships.description: [EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN] Wright-Giemsa or touch imprint microscopy reveals 3-8 µm intracellular yeast cells featuring a pathognomonic central transverse dividing septum.

relationships.keywords: EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN, binary fission division, non-budding, fission yeast, cross-wall
relationships.description: [EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN] Direct microscopic examination confirms that parasitic yeast forms divide exclusively by binary fission without narrow-based or broad-based budding.

relationships.keywords: EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN, macrophage yeast ingestion, intracellular yeasts, histiocytic ingestion
relationships.description: [EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN] Microscopic cytology shows histiocytes and monocytes heavily engorged with numerous round, oval, and sausage-shaped fungal yeast bodies.

relationships.keywords: EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN, diffusible red pigment, wine-red pigment, culture hallmark, Sabouraud agar
relationships.description: [EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN] Mould colonies cultured on Sabouraud dextrose agar at 25°C produce a soluble brick-red to deep wine-red pigment diffusing into the agar within 3-5 days.

relationships.keywords: EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN, thermal dimorphic conversion, dimorphism, 25C mould, 37C yeast
relationships.description: [EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN] Confirmatory phenotypic identification demonstrates thermal transition from sporulating mould at 25°C to fission yeast at 37°C on enriched media.

relationships.keywords: EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN, severe CD4 lymphopenia, CD4 < 100, advanced HIV, flow cytometry
relationships.description: [EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN] Admission flow cytometry demonstrates profound cell-mediated immunodeficiency with absolute CD4+ T-cell count < 100 cells/µL, often < 50 cells/µL.

relationships.keywords: EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN, profound normocytic anemia, low hemoglobin, anemia of chronic disease
relationships.description: [EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN] Admission complete blood count demonstrates severe normocytic normochromic anemia (hemoglobin < 7-8 g/dL) secondary to marrow suppression.

relationships.keywords: EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN, severe thrombocytopenia, low platelets, bleeding risk, marrow failure
relationships.description: [EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN] Platelet count drops severely below 50,000/µL due to extensive splenic sequestration, histiocytic hemophagocytosis, and marrow replacement.

relationships.keywords: EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN, severe leukopenia, low white blood cells, marrow hypoplasia
relationships.description: [EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN] Total white blood cell count falls below 3,000/µL, reflecting marked marrow suppression and hypersplenism.

relationships.keywords: EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN, bone marrow pancytopenia, pancytopenia, marrow infiltration
relationships.description: [EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN] Concomitant depression of erythroid, myeloid, and megakaryocytic cell lines leads to profound peripheral pancytopenia in up to 50% of patients.

relationships.keywords: EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN, elevated alkaline phosphatase, high ALP, hepatic infiltration, cholestatic pattern
relationships.description: [EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN] Serum alkaline phosphatase (ALP) is markedly elevated to 3-5 times the upper limit of normal due to hepatic reticuloendothelial infiltration.

relationships.keywords: EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN, elevated gamma-glutamyl transferase, high GGT, cholestatic enzymes
relationships.description: [EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN] Serum GGT is markedly elevated in parallel with alkaline phosphatase, reflecting infiltrative granulomatous cholangiopathy.

relationships.keywords: EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN, moderate serum transaminitis, elevated AST ALT, hepatic inflammation
relationships.description: [EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN] Serum AST and ALT levels are moderately elevated (2-3 times upper limit of normal) due to hepatocellular necrosis from fungal replication.

relationships.keywords: EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN, normal serum bilirubin, dissociated LFT, anicteric hepatitis
relationships.description: [EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN] Total and direct serum bilirubin remain normal or only mildly elevated, creating a classic infiltrative dissociated liver enzyme profile.

relationships.keywords: EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN, extreme hyperferritinemia, high ferritin, macrophage activation, HLH marker
relationships.description: [EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN] Serum ferritin levels exceed 1,000 to 10,000 ng/mL, serving as a powerful biomarker of intense macrophage hyperactivation and reactive HLH.

relationships.keywords: EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN, elevated C-reactive protein, high CRP, acute phase reactant
relationships.description: [EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN] Serum CRP is markedly increased above 50-100 mg/L on admission, indicating profound systemic inflammatory activation.

relationships.keywords: EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN, markedly elevated ESR, high ESR, inflammatory marker
relationships.description: [EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN] Erythrocyte sedimentation rate exceeds 80-100 mm/h, reflecting severe polyclonal hypergammaglobulinemia and tissue injury.

relationships.keywords: EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN, elevated lactate dehydrogenase, high LDH, tissue turnover
relationships.description: [EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN] Serum LDH is significantly elevated (>500-1,000 U/L), correlating with fungal burden, cell turnover, and systemic disease severity.

relationships.keywords: EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN, elevated beta-D-glucan, high BDG, fungal cell wall biomarker
relationships.description: [EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN] Serum (1,3)-beta-D-glucan levels are markedly elevated (>500 pg/mL), providing strong pan-fungal serological evidence of invasive mycosis.

relationships.keywords: EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN, serum Mp1p antigenemia, Mp1p antigen, fungal biomarker, ELISA
relationships.description: [EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN] Enzyme immunoassay detects circulating Talaromyces marneffei cell wall mannoprotein Mp1p with high diagnostic sensitivity and specificity.

relationships.keywords: EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN, urine Mp1p antigenuria, urine antigen, non-invasive biomarker
relationships.description: [EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN] Urine Mp1p antigen enzyme immunoassay yields rapid positive detection of fungal mannoprotein, serving as an effective non-invasive triage test.

relationships.keywords: EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN, positive blood culture, lysis centrifugation, fungal isolation
relationships.description: [EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN] Lysis-centrifugation fungal blood cultures become positive within 48 to 96 hours, demonstrating high organism burden in systemic fungemia.

relationships.keywords: EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN, bone marrow histiocytosis, marrow aspirate, histiocytic hyperplasia
relationships.description: [EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN] Bone marrow aspirate smear and trephine core biopsy reveal sheets of histiocytes filled with characteristic transverse septate yeasts.

relationships.keywords: EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN, skin scraping cytology, touch prep, Giemsa smear, bedside cytology
relationships.description: [EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN] Direct microscopic examination of scraped necrotic exudate stained with Giemsa provides immediate bedside diagnostic confirmation.

relationships.keywords: EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN, GMS septate staining, silver stain, fungal cell wall
relationships.description: [EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN] Gomori methenamine silver (GMS) staining delineates intensely black fungal cell walls with prominent transverse division planes.

relationships.keywords: EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN, hypoalbuminemia, low albumin, negative acute phase reactant
relationships.description: [EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN] Serum albumin drops severely (<2.5-3.0 g/dL) due to negative acute-phase response, chronic cachexia, and intestinal protein loss.

relationships.keywords: IMAGING_FINDING, reticulonodular chest infiltrates, chest radiograph, interstitial infiltrates
relationships.description: [IMAGING_FINDING] Chest radiography demonstrates diffuse, bilateral interstitial reticulonodular opacities throughout all lung zones mimicking miliary infection.

relationships.keywords: IMAGING_FINDING, patchy alveolar consolidation, consolidation, ground glass, chest CT
relationships.description: [IMAGING_FINDING] Plain chest radiographs and thoracic CT show multifocal non-segmental alveolar consolidations and dense ground-glass infiltrates.

relationships.keywords: IMAGING_FINDING, cavitary pulmonary nodules, cavitary lung lesion, chest CT
relationships.description: [IMAGING_FINDING] High-resolution chest CT reveals multiple thick-walled or thin-walled cavitary nodules, particularly in upper lung lobes.

relationships.keywords: IMAGING_FINDING, mediastinal lymphadenopathy, hilar adenopathy, thoracic CT
relationships.description: [IMAGING_FINDING] Chest CT reveals marked enlargement of paratracheal, subcarinal, and hilar lymph node stations with central low attenuation.

relationships.keywords: IMAGING_FINDING, hepatic microabscesses, hypoechoic liver lesions, liver ultrasound
relationships.description: [IMAGING_FINDING] Abdominal ultrasound and CT demonstrate diffuse hepatomegaly containing multiple tiny discrete hypoechoic microabscesses (<1 cm).

relationships.keywords: IMAGING_FINDING, splenic microabscesses, hypoechoic spleen lesions, splenic ultrasound
relationships.description: [IMAGING_FINDING] Bedside abdominal ultrasound demonstrates multiple rounded hypoechoic lesions scattered throughout an enlarged splenic parenchyma.

relationships.keywords: IMAGING_FINDING, mesenteric adenopathy, retroperitoneal adenopathy, abdominal ultrasound
relationships.description: [IMAGING_FINDING] Abdominal ultrasonography and CT show multiple enlarged, confluent mesenteric and retroperitoneal lymph nodes (>1.5 cm in diameter).

relationships.keywords: IMAGING_FINDING, punched-out osteolysis, lytic bone lesion, skeletal plain film
relationships.description: [IMAGING_FINDING] Plain radiographs and CT bone windows demonstrate sharply circumscribed, punched-out osteolytic bone destruction lacking periosteal new bone.

relationships.keywords: IMAGING_FINDING, calvarial lytic lesions, skull radiograph, punched out skull
relationships.description: [IMAGING_FINDING] Skull radiographs reveal multiple focal osteolytic defects involving inner and outer calvarial tables.

relationships.keywords: IMAGING_FINDING, fungal spondylodiscitis, vertebral osteomyelitis, spine MRI
relationships.description: [IMAGING_FINDING] Spine MRI shows vertebral endplate destruction, collapse, and adjacent epidural abscess formation secondary to hematogenous fungal osteomyelitis.

relationships.keywords: IMAGING_FINDING, subcutaneous fluid collections, cold abscess ultrasound, soft tissue imaging
relationships.description: [IMAGING_FINDING] Soft-tissue ultrasound demonstrates complex hypoechoic or anechoic subcutaneous fluid pockets corresponding to cold abscesses.

relationships.keywords: IMAGING_FINDING, pleural blunting, costophrenic angle, pleural effusion radiograph
relationships.description: [IMAGING_FINDING] Chest radiography demonstrates blunting of the costophrenic angles indicative of reactive inflammatory pleural effusion.

relationships.keywords: EXPOSURE_TO, endemic Southeast Asia, travel history, geographic risk, tropical medicine
relationships.description: [EXPOSURE_TO] Residence or travel in endemic tropical Southeast Asia, including Thailand, Vietnam, Myanmar, Laos, and Cambodia, provides the primary geographic exposure.

relationships.keywords: EXPOSURE_TO, southern China travel, Guangxi, Guangdong, Yunnan, endemic region
relationships.description: [EXPOSURE_TO] Residence or travel history in southern Chinese provinces, including Guangxi, Guangdong, Yunnan, and Hong Kong, constitutes a major geographic risk factor.

relationships.keywords: EXPOSURE_TO, Northeast India residence, Manipur, Assam, geographic exposure
relationships.description: [EXPOSURE_TO] Travel or residence in endemic regions of Northeast India, particularly the state of Manipur and Assam, represents an established geographic exposure.

relationships.keywords: EXPOSURE_TO, bamboo rat burrows, Rhizomys pruinosus, Cannomys badius, animal reservoir
relationships.description: [EXPOSURE_TO] Proximity to burrows and habitats of wild bamboo rats (Rhizomys pruinosus and Cannomys badius) increases risk of aerosolized spore exposure.

relationships.keywords: EXPOSURE_TO, agricultural soil contact, farming, soil exposure, occupational risk
relationships.description: [EXPOSURE_TO] Direct occupational exposure to disturbed agricultural soil, farming, digging, or rural earthwork facilitates conidial inhalation.

relationships.keywords: EXPOSURE_TO, monsoon rainy season, seasonality, rainfall peak, spore dispersal
relationships.description: [EXPOSURE_TO] Transmission peaks sharply during the rainy monsoon season (May to October), when soil moisture and humidity favor fungal sporulation.

relationships.keywords: EXPOSURE_TO, conidial aerosol inhalation, airborne transmission, respiratory route
relationships.description: [EXPOSURE_TO] Primary infection occurs via inhalation of microscopic airborne environmental conidia into the terminal pulmonary alveoli.

relationships.keywords: EXPOSURE_TO, bamboo rat butchering, culinary exposure, animal contact
relationships.description: [EXPOSURE_TO] Trapping, skinning, butchering, or handling wild bamboo rats for culinary preparation poses exposure to aerosolized and percutaneous fungi.

relationships.keywords: EXPOSURE_TO, subterranean cave exploration, spelunking, cave dust, rodent habitat
relationships.description: [EXPOSURE_TO] Spelunking or working in limestone caves inhabited by rodents and bats exposes individuals to aerosolized microconidia.

relationships.keywords: EXPOSURE_TO, forestry occupational exposure, logging, bamboo clearing, occupational hazard
relationships.description: [EXPOSURE_TO] Occupational clearing of bamboo groves, logging, and forestry work generate infectious dust clouds carrying environmental fungal spores.

relationships.keywords: EXPOSURE_TO, monsoon flood silt, floodwater, soil silt, environmental disruption
relationships.description: [EXPOSURE_TO] Exposure to muddy flood silt and contaminated surface soil during seasonal flood events enhances inhalation and inoculation risk.

relationships.keywords: HIGH_RISK_HOST, advanced HIV infection, AIDS, severe immunosuppression, CD4 < 100
relationships.description: [HIGH_RISK_HOST] Patients with advanced untreated or failing HIV infection and CD4 counts < 100 cells/µL represent over 80% of clinical cases.

relationships.keywords: HIGH_RISK_HOST, anti-IFN-gamma autoantibodies, adult-onset immunodeficiency, non-HIV host
relationships.description: [HIGH_RISK_HOST] Adults producing high-titer neutralizing autoantibodies against interferon-gamma suffer severe disseminated talaromycosis with osteoarticular predilection.

relationships.keywords: HIGH_RISK_HOST, hematologic malignancy, lymphoma, leukemia, myeloma, host risk factor
relationships.description: [HIGH_RISK_HOST] Patients with underlying hematologic neoplasms, such as lymphoma, leukemia, and multiple myeloma, have high susceptibility to disseminated infection.

relationships.keywords: HIGH_RISK_HOST, solid organ transplantation, transplant recipient, immunosuppressive drugs
relationships.description: [HIGH_RISK_HOST] Recipients of solid organ transplants receiving calcineurin inhibitors and antimetabolites are at increased risk of opportunistic dissemination.

relationships.keywords: HIGH_RISK_HOST, anti-CD20 therapy, rituximab, B-cell depletion, biological therapy
relationships.description: [HIGH_RISK_HOST] Patients receiving B-cell depleting monoclonal antibodies like rituximab exhibit impaired humoral and cellular immunity predisposing to severe disease.

relationships.keywords: HIGH_RISK_HOST, Bruton kinase inhibitors, ibrutinib, BTK inhibitor, kinase inhibitor
relationships.description: [HIGH_RISK_HOST] Therapy with ibrutinib and other kinase inhibitors impairs macrophage and microglial fungal containment, allowing rapid dissemination.

relationships.keywords: HIGH_RISK_HOST, prolonged corticosteroid therapy, prednisone, glucocorticoids, steroid risk
relationships.description: [HIGH_RISK_HOST] Chronic high-dose systemic glucocorticoid administration severely blunts cell-mediated immunity, enabling dormant fungal reactivation.

relationships.keywords: HIGH_RISK_HOST, Janus kinase inhibitors, JAK inhibitor, targeted immunosuppressant
relationships.description: [HIGH_RISK_HOST] Patients receiving tofacitinib, ruxolitinib, or other JAK inhibitors suffer blunted cytokine signaling that enables invasive talaromycosis.

relationships.keywords: HIGH_RISK_HOST, HLA-DRB1*1602 genotype, genetic susceptibility, HLA association
relationships.description: [HIGH_RISK_HOST] Individuals carrying HLA-DRB1*16:02 and HLA-DQB1*05:02 alleles have strong genetic predisposition to developing neutralizing anti-IFN-gamma autoantibodies.

relationships.keywords: INCUBATION_PERIOD, incubation of weeks, acute incubation, symptom timeline
relationships.description: [INCUBATION_PERIOD] Clinical manifestations typically emerge 1 to 3 weeks following high-inoculum environmental conidial inhalation.

relationships.keywords: INCUBATION_PERIOD, decade latent reactivation, latent period, reactivation timeline
relationships.description: [INCUBATION_PERIOD] Dormant fungal foci can reactivate years or decades after departure from endemic Southeast Asia upon subsequent immunosuppression.

relationships.keywords: RULED_OUT_BY, exclusion criterion, negative boundary, narrow-necked budding, Histoplasma
relationships.description: [RULED_OUT_BY] Microscopic observation of narrow-based budding yeasts rules out Talaromyces marneffei, which reproduces strictly by transverse binary fission without budding.

relationships.keywords: RULED_OUT_BY, exclusion criterion, negative boundary, broad-based budding, Blastomyces
relationships.description: [RULED_OUT_BY] Identification of large fungal cells with broad-based budding rules out Talaromyces marneffei and establishes the diagnosis of Blastomycosis.

relationships.keywords: RULED_OUT_BY, exclusion criterion, negative boundary, mariner wheel budding, Paracoccidioides
relationships.description: [RULED_OUT_BY] Presence of yeasts with circumferential multiple daughter buds (mariner's wheel pattern) rules out Talaromyces and diagnoses Paracoccidioidomycosis.

relationships.keywords: RULED_OUT_BY, exclusion criterion, negative boundary, mucicarmine capsule, Cryptococcus
relationships.description: [RULED_OUT_BY] Demonstration of a thick mucicarmine-positive or India ink-positive polysaccharide capsule rules out Talaromyces and confirms Cryptococcus neoformans.

relationships.keywords: RULED_OUT_BY, exclusion criterion, negative boundary, spherules with endospores, Coccidioides
relationships.description: [RULED_OUT_BY] Detection of large, thick-walled spherules containing internal endospores rules out Talaromyces marneffei in favor of Coccidioidomycosis.

relationships.keywords: RULED_OUT_BY, exclusion criterion, negative boundary, acid-fast bacilli, Mycobacterium
relationships.description: [RULED_OUT_BY] Staining demonstrating acid-fast bacilli on Ziehl-Neelsen or auramine-rhodamine stain rules out fungal infection and establishes Mycobacterial infection.

relationships.keywords: RULED_OUT_BY, exclusion criterion, negative boundary, Henderson-Paterson bodies, molluscum
relationships.description: [RULED_OUT_BY] Histopathological discovery of large intracytoplasmic viral molluscum bodies in keratinocytes rules out fungal etiology in favor of Molluscum contagiosum.

relationships.keywords: RULED_OUT_BY, exclusion criterion, negative boundary, no endemic travel, geographic exclusion
relationships.description: [RULED_OUT_BY] Complete lifetime absence of travel or residence in endemic Southeast Asia or southern China effectively excludes Talaromyces marneffei infection.

relationships.keywords: RULED_OUT_BY, exclusion criterion, negative boundary, normal CD4 count, immunocompetent host
relationships.description: [RULED_OUT_BY] A normal CD4 T-cell count (>500 cells/µL) in an immunocompetent host without autoantibodies strongly argues against disseminated talaromycosis.

relationships.keywords: RULED_OUT_BY, exclusion criterion, negative boundary, colorless culture, no red pigment
relationships.description: [RULED_OUT_BY] Fungal culture at 25°C failing to produce a diffusible brick-red or wine-red pigment on Sabouraud dextrose agar excludes Talaromyces marneffei.

relationships.keywords: RULED_OUT_BY, exclusion criterion, negative boundary, antibacterial response, beta-lactam cure
relationships.description: [RULED_OUT_BY] Prompt defervescence and clinical recovery within 48 to 72 hours of antibacterial beta-lactam therapy rules out fungal talaromycosis.

relationships.keywords: RULED_OUT_BY, exclusion criterion, negative boundary, negative Mp1p antigen, ruled out
relationships.description: [RULED_OUT_BY] Persistently negative serum and urine Mp1p enzyme immunoassays combined with negative blood cultures effectively rules out active talaromycosis.

relationships.keywords: RULED_OUT_BY, exclusion criterion, negative boundary, normal beta-D-glucan, negative BDG
relationships.description: [RULED_OUT_BY] Undetectable serum (1,3)-beta-D-glucan in a severely symptomatic immunocompromised patient strongly argues against invasive systemic fungal infection.

relationships.keywords: RULED_OUT_BY, exclusion criterion, negative boundary, Gram-negative bacilli, melioidosis
relationships.description: [RULED_OUT_BY] Rapid isolation of Gram-negative bacilli with safety-pin bipolar staining rules in bacterial melioidosis and rules out primary fungal disease.

relationships.keywords: RULED_OUT_BY, exclusion criterion, negative boundary, tissue pseudohyphae, Candida
relationships.description: [RULED_OUT_BY] Presence of true branching pseudohyphae and blastoconidia in histopathological specimens confirms invasive candidiasis and excludes Talaromyces.

relationships.keywords: RULED_OUT_BY, exclusion criterion, negative boundary, aseptate hyphae, Mucorales
relationships.description: [RULED_OUT_BY] Histological identification of broad, irregular, ribbon-like aseptate hyphae with right-angle branching rules out Talaromyces in favor of Mucorales.

relationships.keywords: RULED_OUT_BY, exclusion criterion, negative boundary, 45-degree hyphae, Aspergillus
relationships.description: [RULED_OUT_BY] Demonstration of acutely branching (45-degree) dichotomous septate hyphae in necrotic tissue establishes invasive Aspergillosis.

relationships.keywords: RULED_OUT_BY, exclusion criterion, negative boundary, normal ALP, normal alkaline phosphatase
relationships.description: [RULED_OUT_BY] A completely normal alkaline phosphatase and GGT in the setting of severe hepatosplenomegaly strongly argues against reticuloendothelial talaromycosis.

relationships.keywords: RULED_OUT_BY, exclusion criterion, negative boundary, superficial lesions, no systemic signs
relationships.description: [RULED_OUT_BY] Isolated superficial skin papules without constitutional fever, weight loss, organomegaly, or cytopenia rule out disseminated talaromycosis.

relationships.keywords: RULED_OUT_BY, exclusion criterion, negative boundary, kinetoplast amastigotes, Leishmania
relationships.description: [RULED_OUT_BY] Identification of intracellular amastigotes containing a distinct bar-shaped kinetoplast rules out fungal infection and confirms Leishmaniasis.

relationships.keywords: RULED_OUT_BY, exclusion criterion, negative boundary, dermatomal rash, herpes zoster
relationships.description: [RULED_OUT_BY] Strictly unilateral, dermatomal vesicular or crusted eruptions rule out talaromycosis and confirm herpes zoster infection.

relationships.keywords: RULED_OUT_BY, exclusion criterion, negative boundary, positive treponemal serology, syphilis
relationships.description: [RULED_OUT_BY] High-titer reactive RPR and treponemal antibody testing in the presence of palmar-plantar rash rules in secondary syphilis rather than fungal infection.

relationships.keywords: DIFFERENTIATED_FROM, look-alike, differential diagnosis, Histoplasmosis, budding yeast
relationships.description: [DIFFERENTIATED_FROM] Unlike Histoplasma capsulatum which reproduces by narrow-based budding and produces no pigment, Talaromyces marneffei divides by binary transverse fission and secretes wine-red pigment at 25°C.

relationships.keywords: DIFFERENTIATED_FROM, look-alike, differential diagnosis, Cryptococcosis, capsule, meningitis
relationships.description: [DIFFERENTIATED_FROM] Cryptococcus neoformans produces thick mucicarmine-positive gelatinous capsules, causes predominantly meningitis, and reproduces by budding, whereas Talaromyces lacks a capsule and divides by fission.

relationships.keywords: DIFFERENTIATED_FROM, look-alike, differential diagnosis, Molluscum Contagiosum, Henderson-Paterson
relationships.description: [DIFFERENTIATED_FROM] Molluscum contagiosum produces superficially similar umbilicated papules but entirely lacks systemic fever, organomegaly, cytopenias, or internal dissemination, showing viral Henderson-Paterson bodies on histology.

relationships.keywords: DIFFERENTIATED_FROM, look-alike, differential diagnosis, Miliary Tuberculosis, acid-fast bacilli
relationships.description: [DIFFERENTIATED_FROM] Miliary tuberculosis causes fever, wasting, and lung micronodules but lacks necrotic umbilicated facial papules, and reveals acid-fast bacilli on Ziehl-Neelsen stain rather than fungal yeasts.

relationships.keywords: DIFFERENTIATED_FROM, look-alike, differential diagnosis, Secondary Syphilis, treponemal serology
relationships.description: [DIFFERENTIATED_FROM] Secondary syphilis features widespread maculopapular rash on palms and soles with positive treponemal serology, but lacks central necrotic umbilication, osteolytic lesions, and intracellular septate yeasts.

relationships.keywords: DIFFERENTIATED_FROM, look-alike, differential diagnosis, Visceral Leishmaniasis, amastigotes
relationships.description: [DIFFERENTIATED_FROM] Visceral leishmaniasis shares fever, pancytopenia, and massive splenomegaly but amastigotes possess a distinct rod-shaped kinetoplast, lack fungal cell walls, and do not cause umbilicated facial lesions.

relationships.keywords: DIFFERENTIATED_FROM, look-alike, differential diagnosis, Coccidioidomycosis, spherules
relationships.description: [DIFFERENTIATED_FROM] Coccidioides produces large endosporulating spherules (20-100 µm) in tissue and is endemic to arid American deserts, contrasting with the Southeast Asian fission-dividing yeast Talaromyces.

relationships.keywords: DIFFERENTIATED_FROM, look-alike, differential diagnosis, Pneumocystis Jirovecii Pneumonia, PCP
relationships.description: [DIFFERENTIATED_FROM] Pneumocystis presents with bilateral interstitial infiltrates in advanced HIV but entirely lacks umbilicated cutaneous papules, osteolytic bone lesions, and hepatosplenomegaly, exhibiting non-budding trophic cysts.

relationships.keywords: DIFFERENTIATED_FROM, look-alike, differential diagnosis, Bacillary Angiomatosis, Bartonella
relationships.description: [DIFFERENTIATED_FROM] Bartonella infection causes vascular, friable, non-umbilicated violaceous nodules that bleed easily, showing clusters of silver-stained bacilli rather than intracellular fungal yeasts.

relationships.keywords: DIFFERENTIATED_FROM, look-alike, differential diagnosis, Cutaneous Leishmaniasis, localized ulcer
relationships.description: [DIFFERENTIATED_FROM] Cutaneous leishmaniasis manifests as localized, non-umbilicated chronic skin ulcers with raised borders without reticuloendothelial dissemination or systemic fungal culture positivity.

relationships.keywords: DIFFERENTIATED_FROM, look-alike, differential diagnosis, Blastomycosis, broad-based budding
relationships.description: [DIFFERENTIATED_FROM] Blastomyces dermatitidis produces large (8-15 µm) yeasts with characteristic broad-based budding and thick refractory walls, whereas Talaromyces produces smaller fission yeasts dividing by internal septa.

relationships.keywords: DIFFERENTIATED_FROM, look-alike, differential diagnosis, Paracoccidioidomycosis, mariner's wheel
relationships.description: [DIFFERENTIATED_FROM] Paracoccidioides brasiliensis is restricted to Latin America and produces multiple budding daughter yeasts in a mariner's wheel pattern, unlike the fission-dividing yeasts of Talaromyces.

relationships.keywords: DIFFERENTIATED_FROM, look-alike, differential diagnosis, Kaposi Sarcoma, HHV-8, vascular tumor
relationships.description: [DIFFERENTIATED_FROM] Kaposi sarcoma produces non-tender violaceous macules and plaques without central dells or necrotic crusts, demonstrating HHV-8 spindle cell proliferation rather than intracellular fungi.

relationships.keywords: DIFFERENTIATED_FROM, look-alike, differential diagnosis, Cutaneous Aspergillosis, septate hyphae
relationships.description: [DIFFERENTIATED_FROM] Aspergillus produces necrotic skin eschars with 45-degree branching septate hyphae in tissue, lacking the dimorphic yeast phase and transverse fission septa characteristic of Talaromyces.

relationships.keywords: DIFFERENTIATED_FROM, look-alike, differential diagnosis, Non-Hodgkin Lymphoma, lymphoma
relationships.description: [DIFFERENTIATED_FROM] Non-Hodgkin lymphoma shares B-symptoms and generalized lymphadenopathy but lymph node biopsy shows malignant clonal lymphoid proliferation without microorganisms, and cultures are sterile.

relationships.keywords: DIFFERENTIATED_FROM, look-alike, differential diagnosis, Scrub Typhus, eschar, doxycycline response
relationships.description: [DIFFERENTIATED_FROM] Orientia tsutsugamushi causes acute fever and lymphadenopathy with a single black eschar with red halo, resolving rapidly with doxycycline within 48 hours, lacking crops of umbilicated facial papules.

relationships.keywords: DIFFERENTIATED_FROM, look-alike, differential diagnosis, Melioidosis, Burkholderia, safety-pin bacilli
relationships.description: [DIFFERENTIATED_FROM] Burkholderia pseudomallei causes severe bacteremia and visceral abscesses in Southeast Asia but is a Gram-negative bacillus responding to ceftazidime, lacking umbilicated necrotic papules and fungal yeast cells.

relationships.keywords: DIFFERENTIATED_FROM, look-alike, differential diagnosis, Lepromatous Leprosy, leonine facies, neuropathy
relationships.description: [DIFFERENTIATED_FROM] Lepromatous leprosy causes infiltrative facial plaques and earlobe thickening with peripheral nerve enlargement and sensory deficits, staining strongly acid-fast without acute high fever or osteolysis.
